role: combined candidate; run in parallel with the three controls for forward tracking

selection.empty_intersection: instead of holding the previous portfolio, take the single name with the highest deltaC among the RV top-3
selection.rationale: holding a stale name that satisfies neither condition is the main source of lag; the fallback guarantees every holding meets at least one current condition

execution.rule: if the selected industry is semis or communications, replace with its highest-deltaC L3 child; otherwise keep the L2
execution.etf: 250d correlation vs the chosen index >= 0.80, top 8, then rank by 0.5*beta_rank + 0.5*HA77_composite_rank

timing: unchanged: deltaAR(1.5) hysteresis x TIP 21/63/126/252 calendar gate, next-day effect, residual H11006

evidence.complementarity: L3 execution lifts 2019-2023 (1.196 -> 1.304, MDD -24.8% -> -20.2%); the fallback lifts 2024-2026 (2.573 -> 2.920); the two act on different regimes

rejected_hypotheses.looser_reentry: opening at deltaAR<0.5 or <1.0, and 60/120-day timeouts, all flat or worse (1.539 -> 1.527 / 1.449 / 1.521)
rejected_hypotheses.single_name_cap: capping at one holding drops full Sharpe to 1.207

known_limitations: 1.825 is the product of sequential in-sample tuning across 5-6 decisions; realistic out-of-sample expectation is lower
max drawdown stays near -24.5%: all gains are on the return side, nothing addresses the all-bond regime
ETF ranking uses the HA 77-factor composite frozen at 2026-06-30
next: run four versions in parallel (18 flat / +L3 / +fallback / combined) for forward shadow tracking; choose on live evidence, not more history
